nurse.line1: Your job is nursing the colony's babies.
nurse.line2: Gather fungus from the garden and bring it to the nursery.
nurse.line3: Feed the larvae and help manage their juvenile hormone.

forager.line1: Your job is cutting leaves on the foraging trail.
forager.line2: Snip leaf pieces outside and carry them home.
forager.line3: The colony uses those leaves to grow its fungus farm.

gardener.line1: Your job is tending the fungus garden.
gardener.line2: Keep the fungus healthy and tidy.
gardener.line3: Healthy fungus feeds every ant in the nest.

soldier.line1: Your job is guarding the nest.
soldier.line2: Patrol and face strangers at the edge of the colony.
soldier.line3: You shake and scare them away — nobody gets hurt.

waste.line1: Your job is keeping the nest clean.
waste.line2: Carry old bits and trash to the dump.
waste.line3: Clean gardens stay safer and grow better food.

scout.line1: Your job is exploring the deep trail.
scout.line2: Walk the deep tunnels and learn how the nest is built.
scout.line3: Exploring helps the colony find new rooms.
